Press kit

COMPLETE-ME is an open-source Rust tool for Bash, zsh, and fish. It generates missing shell completions and fills command arguments with values from the tools you use.

Release and assets

  • Download the press release (text)
  • Download the COMPLETE-ME terminal mark (SVG)
  • Try the terminal demo

Project facts

  • Project COMPLETE-ME
  • License MIT
  • Shells Bash, zsh, and fish
  • Distribution Source and installer through the public GitHub repository
  • Browser demo Recorded Bash, fish, and zsh completions side by side

For project questions, use the public issue tracker.
